narrative: The landing scene, dry ink, a fresh margin down the right. No candle. The Flint leaf lies under this one, untouched. No new speech under the old one. A tick beside the captain's first line, and the pen still in the hand.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ticked the captain and went on to the next mouth.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in King, as service
